# exemplar subject

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:exemplarSubject`](gmeow-exemplarSubject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exemplarSubject>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The entity whose pattern the exemplar evidences — a frame-scoped character whose conduct across the cited work is the example (design context: 823 such links in the foundation corpus), an organization, a person. Range intentionally open. NOT functional, optional: span-pinned exemplars need no subject, and subject + selector may coexist (the span shows one instance of the pattern; the subject names its bearer). At least one of [`viaSelector`](gmeow-viaSelector.md) / [`exemplarSubject`](gmeow-exemplarSubject.md) (SHACL).

Use [`gmeow:exemplarSubject`](gmeow-exemplarSubject.md) from [`gmeow:Exemplar`](../classes/gmeow-Exemplar.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the entity whose pattern an exemplar evidences — a character whose conduct across the cited work is the example, an organization, a person.

### Avoid when

- Avoid requiring it on span-pinned exemplars (a selector alone suffices — at least one of selector or subject is required) and avoid forcing a single subject; it is non-functional and optional.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:exemplarSubject`](gmeow-exemplarSubject.md) at the bearer entity; combine it with the citation [`Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) when both the instance span and its bearer matter.
